description: Compare 2 to 5 robot lawn mowers side by side across navigation, coverage, slope, cutting specs, price and the 0-5 BestRobotMower Score. Pass each model by name or slug.

models.description: 2 to 5 model names or slugs to compare.

name: compare_robot_mowers

comparison_page.description: The side-by-side page for exactly these models on BestRobotMower.co, with every store's price.

missing.description: Queries that matched no model in the dataset.

in_stock.description: The store's stock at that read; null when the store does not say.

max_lawn_area_acres.description: The rated lawn area in acres (1 acre = 4,046.86 m2).

price_as_of.description: When that store's price was last read.

below_30_day_low_usd.description: How far the price sits below that 30-day low, in USD.

deals_page.description: The page that lists every real drop the site has found (the Black Friday report while it runs).

previous_30_day_low_usd.description: The lowest price the same store charged in the 30 days before this price.

since.description: When the store's price first read at this level (ISO).

price_drop.description: A real price drop for this model: a store's price below the lowest price that same store charged in the 30 days before. Null when no store the site reads has one.

price_is_live.description: True when the price was read from the store's own feed on its date.

price_provider.description: The store that price is from.

price_usd.description: The lowest current price the site tracks for this model, in USD.

url.description: The model's page on BestRobotMower.co: full specs, sources, every store's price and price history.

title: Compare robot mowers
